benchmark: Economic OS Standards Interoperability Semantic Crosswalk

crosswalk.non_equivalence: Intent is not actual owner effect or delivery
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Keep as plan node; bind stable operation identity and later evidence references
Create distinct owner effects for fulfilment claims; preserve partial quantities

crosswalk.non_equivalence: Claim is not authority merely because it is represented in an ontology
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Bind claim profile digest and required effect IDs; evaluate evidence scope

crosswalk.non_equivalence: EconomicEvent mapping does not prove legal authority or external finality
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Bind author/source, event time, resource, quantity and evidence; separate effect owner

crosswalk.non_equivalence: Resource identity does not imply current availability, ownership or title
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Preserve resource ID, unit, custody/owner profile and time-scoped observations

crosswalk.mycelix_mapping: Captured evidence artifact or immutable economic record
crosswalk.non_equivalence: PROV Entity status does not establish truth or completeness
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Content-address bytes; retain source authority, capture time and transformation chain

crosswalk.mycelix_mapping: Import, normalize, validate, post, or reconcile activity
crosswalk.non_equivalence: Activity provenance is not execution authorization
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Record actor/software, inputs, outputs, time and code/profile revision

crosswalk.non_equivalence: Attribution/association is not legal delegation or signing authority
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Verify credentials and separately evaluate scoped authorization

crosswalk.mycelix_mapping: Observed scan, shipment, receiving or transaction event
crosswalk.non_equivalence: Visibility event is not legal title, payment settlement or acceptance
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Bind eventID, eventTime, recordTime, bizStep, disposition and source

crosswalk.non_equivalence: Transformation event does not settle financial obligations
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Map input/output quantity and units; preserve lineage and loss/gain rules

crosswalk.non_equivalence: Initiation is not provider acceptance, booking or settlement
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Retain message version, sender, end-to-end ID, instruction status and external references

crosswalk.non_equivalence: A status value is not universally equivalent to final settlement
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Interpret only under the rail's versioned status/finality profile

crosswalk.non_equivalence: Correction does not erase original economic history
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Append linked compensating effect and preserve original event

crosswalk.mycelix_mapping: Intraday report, statement and debit/credit notification
crosswalk.non_equivalence: Duplicate/overlapping reports must not multiply an effect
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Bind account, statement/report scope, sequence and bank transaction IDs

crosswalk.mycelix_mapping: Invoice amount, tax, parties and references
crosswalk.non_equivalence: Schema/CIUS validation does not prove goods receipt, supplier legitimacy or payment
crosswalk.mapping_rule: Bind exact profile version and validation layers; require independent receipt/settlement evidence
